settings.heading: Personalization
settings.description: Unity uses your recent marketplace activity and saved preferences to tailor what you see. Search results and Sponsored listings are never affected by this.
settings.disabledNotice: Personalization is off. You'll see the same generic discovery as everyone else. Search still works normally.
settings.clearHistoryDesc: Removes your recent-view history. Your orders, bookings, barter trades and reviews are never affected.
settings.clearHistoryConfirmDesc: This resets your recently-viewed activity used for recommendations. Your explicit interests above stay saved. This can't be undone.
settings.clearHistorySuccess: Your personalization history has been cleared.

errors.couldNotLoad: Could not load your personalization settings
errors.couldNotSave: Could not save your personalization settings
errors.couldNotClear: Could not clear your personalization history

emptyState.noHistory: Browse a few items and we'll start tailoring this page for you.
